title: Brazil elections: Lula leads Bolsonaro with 80% of votes in
summary: Votes are being tallied after polling was extended two more hours. Leftist Lula is leading right-wing Bolsonaro as 80% of the vote has been counted. DW has the latest.

image.caption: Conservative Bolsonaro and leftist Lula are facing off in an election which will have massive implications for South America's biggest democracy and its foreign policy Image: Alexandre Meneghini/Agustin Marcarian/REUTERS

blocks.text: Votes being tallied in Brazil's presidential election after polls close
The electronic voting system used in the country means that a final result could be determined within a matter of hours, although that final result is expected to be tight.
